name: Chainsaw Face
description: Chainsaw Face, a masked slasher in a butcher's apron, as a 30 cm (12 in) brick-built figure on a display stand: neck, shoulders, elbows, wrists, waist, hips, knees and ankles all pose, and he swings his chainsaw from high overhead down across his hips.
